research_scope: Official vendor documentation reads only. No provider API/MCP operations, accounts, tokens, registrations, installations, builds or tests.
architecture_findings: No generator is present in the inspected provider package. Manifest and OperationManifest carry request construction, but schema checking in Manifest.validate is structural; strict argument execution needs the shared schema wrapper.

HTTPAdapter has provider-specific validators, headers and application-error guards. New descriptors must not be registered until compiled strict validation and fixed headers/projection are integrated.
GraphQL uses server-owned GraphQLDocument and JSON-marshaled variables. No document, method, origin, raw headers or query text is accepted from callers.
All definitions are read-only, fixed-origin, one attempt and bounded. No runtime availability/card/count changes are made by these files.

Dedicated cross-operation cursor continuation tools are omitted: bound page tokens cannot transfer between operations. Monday items and Dropbox folders are explicitly first-page-only in this initial subset.

notes: Scoped PAT recommended. No database SQL, service-role keys or secret-management endpoints.
external_gates: User-owned Supabase account and scoped PAT; real read pending.

notes: No environment variables, deploy mutations, shell or secrets endpoints.
